title: Poem-1
body:
And thou glance at, 
Rose my sun as 
-Alluring sky apprised me 
“Thou canst dodge me 
Even, if I tumble;” 
Mayst thine cull fate, 
What you see next;

body: Participation in "ABHIYAN: Designing the Future" AI and Machine learning exhibition program.
